claim_one_line: THE REGULAR THREE, run as sealed (a4712e8d; sL-7/sL-8 after B1393): theorem (the physical-bridge lane's R32 Hopf-trace argument generalised): for an order-3 rotation with k = 3m fixed arcs and a g-invariant rank-one flat L with lift, the sum of the arc weights is L(g^; Q); if H*(Q; L) = 0 the weights are balanced and the source-mode module is m copies of the regular representation. P1 holds (96 of 96 acyclic non-trivial pairs balanced). P2: 96 of 192 non-trivial pairs acyclic. P3 SOME, against the sealed prior (NONE ~60%): 54 non-acyclic non-trivial pairs are unbalanced (s959 2, o10_150704 4, o10_150725 2, o10_150729 20, cube~3.24 26); on k = 3 all three arcs carry one weight, on o10_150704 (k = 6) the counts are (4, 1, 1); every one has h1 = h2 >= 2, massless bulk modes of the same charge. They are the only places in the class where a symmetric source three is not regular, registered as a lead for the lane and sL-7.
